driverSettings.title: [hi] Driver Settings
driverSettings.subtitle: [hi] Control your duty status, custom map navigation units, and road alerts.
driverSettings.activeDutyDesc: [hi] Toggle on to appear online and accept backhaul cargo matches.
driverSettings.audioAlertsDesc: [hi] Play a loud ringtone whenever a high-match route is offered.
driverSettings.autoNavigateDesc: [hi] Instantly pull up maps right after accepting a cargo load.
driverSettings.gpsSyncDesc: [hi] Allow dispatchers and buyers to track your truck location during a job.
driverSettings.nightModeDesc: [hi] Switch to a dark-charcoal UI to prevent eye fatigue while driving at night.

driverLoads.title: [hi] Available loads
driverLoads.subtitle: [hi] Loads assigned to you, awaiting response or in progress.
driverLoads.notVisible: [hi] You’re not accepting loads right now
driverLoads.nothingWaitingBody: [hi] When admin assigns you a load, it'll show up here for you to accept or reject.
driverLoads.noActiveLoadsBody: [hi] Loads you've accepted will show up here until they're delivered.

shipperSettings.title: [hi] Shipper Settings
shipperSettings.subtitle: [hi] Control your system preferences, API integrations, and display adjustments.
shipperSettings.milestoneAlertsDesc: [hi] Send real-time alerts whenever custom checks, pickups, or deliveries happen.
shipperSettings.erpSyncDesc: [hi] Restrict third-party software from fetching invoice and tracking data logs.
shipperSettings.darkModeDesc: [hi] Switch between standard light screen and cozy dark-room dashboard mode.

adminSettings.title: [hi] Admin Settings
adminSettings.subtitle: [hi] Control platform-wide configuration, moderation rules, and access policies.
adminSettings.newRegistrationsDesc: [hi] Allow new buyers, shippers, drivers, and agencies to sign up.
adminSettings.autoVerifyDriversDesc: [hi] Skip manual document review for drivers who were previously approved.
adminSettings.maintenanceModeDesc: [hi] Show a maintenance banner and pause new shipment/order matching platform-wide.
adminSettings.autoEscalateDesc: [hi] Flag complaints left open for more than 48 hours for priority review.
adminSettings.requireDocReviewDesc: [hi] Block a vehicle from accepting shipments until its documents are admin-verified.
adminSettings.twoFactorDesc: [hi] Require a secondary sign-in step for all admin accounts.
adminSettings.darkModeDesc: [hi] Switch between bright daylight screen and dark-charcoal mode.
